## Problem

What limitation or workflow gap does this address?

## Proposed Change

Describe the smallest useful implementation.

## Evidence and Evaluation

State the data source, information-availability assumptions, metric, and chronological evaluation plan.

## Claim Boundary

Explain how the change avoids turning a historical prototype result into an unsupported deployment, fault, or savings claim.
